_comment: Honest defaults for what Machine God can reach THROUGH each AI as connected by `machine-god ais` (API key, CLI or bridge). Edit your copy in the config dir (machine-god grid caps edit shows the path); anything you set there wins. true = Machine God has a working path to it, false = it does not (even if the vendor product can do it elsewhere). skills are 0-3 and only break ties.

chatgpt.label: ChatGPT (your account, through the browser bridge)
chatgpt.notes: Its own web search, image generation, code interpreter and the connectors you enabled in ChatGPT run inside ChatGPT. Machine God cannot call them itself: it hands the whole task to ChatGPT. Slow (a browser page), may violate OpenAI's terms.

claude.label: Claude (your claude login, `claude -p`)
claude.notes: Your Claude Code setup (MCP servers, plugins, skills) lives in claude-rs itself. Through `claude -p` from here it answers as text: no tool approvals are possible, so web search and code execution are marked false.

gemini.label: Gemini (API key)
gemini.notes: Plain generateContent call: no search grounding, no tools. Very large context window.

local.label: Local model (Ollama / LM Studio)
local.notes: Runs on this computer; nothing leaves it. Quality depends on the model you installed.

copilot.label: Copilot (GitHub Models, token)
copilot.notes: Chat completions from GitHub Models (default openai/gpt-4.1-mini): text only, rate limited.

grok.label: Grok (xAI API key)
grok.notes: Chat completions only. xAI's live search is not enabled by Machine God.

perplexity.label: Perplexity (API key)
perplexity.notes: Sonar models search the web for every answer.
